items.summary: DeepSeek banned from US federal civilian agencies over spying fears. Singapore firm behind Europe’s only spot Bitcoin ETF, as Switzerland partners with Vietnam on crypto tech.

items.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
items.summary: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

items.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
items.summary: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

items.title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
items.summary: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
items.summary: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

items.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
